My first car was a 2000 Honda Accord. My parent bought it for me in 2014 because I got two years of college for free but had to commute from home.  When I got it I was pretty neutral about it. My parents and I were planning on going and looking at cars on the weekend, but they had gone earlier and decided this was the car for me. The car itself ran pretty well for about 6 months then the transmission started going. As you know automatic transmissions from this era are not good and especially this generation of the accord. If I accelerated too hard to tranny would slip and just rev super high. That being said I still continue to drive it. My best memory is taking it backpacking in the Rainer National Forest. Drove there no issues and even rallied it up to the trailhead. On the way home in the middle of the woods, the transmission completely took a dump and would not go into gear. My buddy and I pulled over to the side of the road and popped the hood to be greeted with tons of thick smoke. Being in the middle of the woods, there was zero cell reception. We tried to flag down any of the many SUV's and Minivan's driving by from the nearby campsites in order to get a ride into the nearest town. After 15 minutes no one had stopped. Then these two mean looking biker guys pull over and take a look at the car and confirm that it is fucked.  They offered us a ride on the back of their Harleys to a nearby resort and that how I ended up riding on the back of a motorcycle in shorts with no helmet. Eventually, we got to the resort and called a tow. Got the transmission replaced and drove it for another year until my step-dad crashed it.
